poses.name: 01_hands_folded
poses.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-body character PNG for an alternate HEXBLADE character cut-in.
Input image: exact character identity, costume, proportions, palette, linework and rendering reference. Redraw the SAME mint-haired maid in a new, relaxed everyday pose.
Keep her very large head and compact chibi body; long thick pale mint wavy hair and chunky pointed curls; heavy asymmetrical fringe hiding viewer-left eye, large pink eye and heavy black lashes on viewer-right; white frilled maid headband; black/pink hair bow with white flower; black-white maid dress, white apron and waist bow, white buttoned cuffs, pink neck bow, white stockings with black/pink bows, chunky black buckle shoes. Fully clothed, same costume and coverage. Match the reference's bold black outline, big clean shapes, subtle grey-violet cel shadows and mint/black/white/pink palette. Do not redesign or make realistic.
Natural body language is the priority: dropped shoulders, soft bent elbows, anatomically relaxed hands and wrists, believable weight over grounded feet, subtle asymmetry. No jumps, sprinting, combat stance, wide power stance, rigid symmetry, dramatic foreshortening, big spread arms or flying hair. Hair hangs softly under gravity, with only small natural curl movement.
Exactly one isolated full-body character on genuine transparent alpha. Portrait composition, character occupies about 88% of canvas height with transparent clearance above headband and below shoes and at both sides. All hair, fingers, bows and shoes fit. No scenery, floor shadow, props, tray, cake, utensils, floating particles, speed lines, trails, text or watermark. Two arms and legs, natural hands, five fingers per hand. One pose, not a pose sheet.
POSE: quietly waiting and welcoming the viewer, front three-quarter view. Both hands loosely overlap at the lower abdomen over the apron, one palm gently resting over the back of the other, fingers softly curved, elbows comfortably close to the body. Not prayer hands and not clenched hands. Weight mainly on one leg, opposite knee softly relaxed and its foot set a little forward, feet naturally close and both on the ground. Head tips a few degrees to one side, visible pink eye looks toward viewer and a small warm closed-mouth smile. Shoulders relaxed; hair falls around body. Easy, unposed everyday maid posture.
